target_claim: Let  $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $n\geq$ lcm$(1,\ldots,k)$, and let $\pi(x):=\sum_{p\leq x} 1$ be the number of primes not greater than $x$. Then in the interval $[n,n+k]$ there are at least $k+1-\pi(k)$ integers $n_i$  with a prime factor $p_i>k$.
